arguments.command:
B=$(git rev-parse origin/main); H=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
npx --no -- commitlint --from "$B" --to "$H" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "good-commits exit=$?"
git worktree add -q /tmp/cl-wt HEAD && (cd /tmp/cl-wt && git commit -q --allow-empty --no-verify -m "release: v0.35.1" && npx --no -- commitlint --from "$B" --to HEAD 2>&1 | grep -E "✖|found"; echo "bad-commit exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"); git worktree remove --force /tmp/cl-wt
npx actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml && echo actionlint-ok
